exception: ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 4)
root_cause: The verifier defines five amendment paths (M1-M5) and unpacks them into four variables. The failure occurs before frozen source hashes are traversed and before any financial parquet or outcome data is opened.
repair_policy: Append-only M6 records this verifier repair and the failed pre-analysis attempt; preserve all prior manifest bytes and amendments.
